description: This file defines the 'Multiplexer' class implementing the 'ReporterV2' interface, managing multiple reporters for test reporting, and includes utility functions for error handling.

classes.name: Multiplexer
classes.description: A class that multiplexes test reporter events to multiple underlying reporters.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Invokes onConfigure on all reporters with the given config.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Invokes onBegin on all reporters with the given suite.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Invokes onTestBegin on all reporters with test and result.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Invokes onStdOut on all reporters with chunk, test, and result.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Invokes onStdErr on all reporters with chunk, test, and result.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes onTestPaused on all reporters.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes onEnd on all reporters and updates overall result status.

methods.name: onExit
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes onExit on all reporters.

methods.name: printsToStdio
methods.description: Returns true if any reporter prints to stdio.
